credentialsInfo: Register an application in the Home Connect Developer Program at developer.home-connect.com, then enter its Client ID and Client Secret here. Both are stored encrypted.
signinInfo: After saving, a one-time sign-in link appears in the adapter log and in the data point auth.verificationUrl. Open it and enter the shown code to authorise the adapter.
aboutInfo: If you find this adapter useful, a small contribution is always appreciated.
